old_wizard_intro.speaker: Old wizard
pages: Ah. A new face. You walked all the way up the hill, so you are either a student or lost.
Either way, you will want these. Four spells, four empty scrolls, and a grimoire with your name on it.
A spell is just an item until it is bound to a scroll. The scriptorium across the quad does the binding.
Fireball first. Everyone does fireball first. Come back when you have twelve of them and we will talk about the real one.

old_wizard_again.speaker: Old wizard
pages: The scriptorium is across the quad. The scribe talks too much, but she binds a clean scroll.
And read something in the library while you are here. Nobody ever does.

sign_gate.speaker: Sign
pages: The Collegium. Scriptorium and Library to the north, harbour to the east. Mind the fountain.

sign_library.speaker: Sign
pages: Great Library. Quiet, please. Also closed until later.

sign_harbour.speaker: Sign
pages: Harbour and boatyard. Blueprints wanted. Fishing permitted, catching not guaranteed.
